## The problem
What is wrong or missing today, in two or three sentences, with a number if there is one.

## Goal and non-goals
What this changes, and what it deliberately does not.

## Design
The shape of the solution: a diagram or a table of components, what each owns, and how a request or event flows through them. Name the modules reused and anything new.

## Controls
Which [standards](../architecture/standards.md) apply, and how each is met: by a test, a check, or an exception with an owner and an expiry.

## Alternatives considered
Each option rejected, and why, in one line.

## Evidence that will show it works
The measurement for each claim, with its control: what is counted, against what baseline, and what result would prove the design wrong.

## Cost
Model calls, tokens and price from the [price file](../../11_finops/prices.yaml), per request and per month at the expected volume.

## Decisions needed
Open questions, each with a recommendation.
